notes: Page 1 covers steps 1-8 of 4904-1. The picture is small and several steps are ambiguous. Step 1-2 are read as plate 2x4 (b1) with plate 2x3 (b2) on its right three columns. Step 3 adds the white handle plate (b3) UNDER the front of b1; it is joined by studs into b1's underside, so its rests_on is empty and the join is given as an edge from b1.

Step 4 plate is read as a 2x3 plate (b4) resting on b2. Step 5 adds two headlight bricks (b5, b6) on the left column of b1, each with a black round 1x1 plate (b7, b8) pushed onto the side stud. Step 6 is read as two black clip plates (b9, b10) on b4; this may be wrong. Step 7 adds a 1x2 plate (b11) on b4.

Step 8 builds two legs (2x): dark 2x2 plate, 1x2 brick, inverted slope 2x2. The legs attach to the underside of the body. The catalogue 3660 has no stud ports, so the leg-to-body joins (b14, b17 to b1) have null ports and the exact body piece is uncertain.
The larger body bricks (brick 2x3, other 1x2 bricks, slopes, ears, hinge) are not clearly visible on this page, so I did not guess them. Later pages should supply them.
Elements (Plate 2x4 second copy, other 3021, 3022 light etc.) were not placed on this page, so they are not listed.
Page 2 has only step 9. The rest of the page is the cover photo, an advert for set 4884 and the website link, so it adds nothing.

Step 9 is a small callout: a dark hinge base (b18), a light gray hinge top plate (b19) and a 1x2 brick (b20) on top. The arrow points to the lower part of a leg, so I attached the hinge base to the foot plate b12. It could be the other foot (b15).
b19 is joined to b18 by the hinge, not by studs, because the catalogue gives 3938 no anti-stud ports.

The first answer built b1 to b20, but the parts list has 34 pieces. This answer adds the 14 missing pieces as b21 to b34: 2540 x2, 3002, 3004, 3020, 3021, 3022 light x2, 3023, 3039 x2, 43722 and 43723. The total is now 34 and every line of the parts list is covered. These are additions only; b1 to b20 and their edges are unchanged.

The booklet image is too small to read steps 4 to 8 exactly, so where these 14 pieces sit is inferred from the photo and the step-8 and step-9 pictures. It is not read from clear steps. The ears (b23, b24) are wedge plates on the 2540 side-handle plates (b21, b22). Those plates clip by their bars onto the black clip plates b9 and b10, which is how the photo shows the ears held.

The body above b4 is a guess: b25 and the clip plates, then plate b26, brick b27, plate b28, two 2x2 plates, two slopes, a 1x2 brick and a 1x2 plate. The slopes are joined only through their two listed stud ports, so their placement is approximate.

In the first answer b9, b10 and b11 were placed at b4 positions that later pieces now sit on. I kept them and built the new pieces over them (b26 rests on b9, b10 and b11). This stays consistent but may not match the booklet exactly.
